name: Web server
desc: nginx serves the files in a folder on your NAS as a website.

name: Nextcloud
desc: Your own cloud: files, calendar and contacts with apps for phone and desktop.
note: The first start copies Nextcloud into {data} and takes several minutes on slow hardware. Then open the web page and create the admin account (SQLite is fine for a few users).

name: PostgreSQL
desc: Database server for your own apps (port 5432).
note: Connect with user postgres on port 5432.

name: Redis
desc: Fast in-memory key-value store and cache (port 6379, local connections only).
note: Protected mode: only programs on the NAS itself can connect.
